---
name: Good First Issue
about: Propose or document an introductory task suitable for first-time contributors
title: '[Good First Issue]: <Short descriptive summary>'
labels: 'good first issue, help wanted'
assignees: ''
---

### 🌟 Overview & Background
A concise description of the beginner-friendly improvement, utility addition, or UI refinement.

### 🎯 Problem Statement / Motivation
Explain why this enhancement improves the platform experience and why it makes a great introductory issue.

### 🛠️ Proposed Solution
Step-by-step guidance on how to implement the solution:
1. Locate the relevant template or script (e.g., `templates/documents/list.html` or `static/js/main.js`).
2. Implement the proposed functionality.
3. Validate mobile responsiveness and keyboard accessibility.

### 📁 Relevant Files
- `static/js/main.js`
- `templates/base.html`
- `templates/documents/list.html`

### ✅ Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Feature works across modern desktop and mobile browsers.
- [ ] No regression in existing automated tests (`python manage.py test`).
- [ ] Clean conventional commit message (e.g., `feat(ui): add keyboard shortcut for search`).
